title: PDNO Control Benchmark: Source Code and Reproducibility Metadata (v1.2.0)
description: Source code and reproducibility metadata accompanying the submission draft Candidate Design, Not Predictor Accuracy, Limits Neural-Operator Control in a PDE Benchmark, by Hyojin Park and Jinhong Yang. Version 1.2.0 adds candidate-design control experiments, saved timing-stage analyses and observer/operator error diagnostics. It preserves the primary evaluation and historical evidence. The Zenodo core contains the source ZIP, evidence manifest, checksum list and scope guide. Large raw outcomes, synthetic trajectories, checkpoints and timing arrays are provided through versioned GitHub releases; the eleven v1.1.0 evidence archives remain explicit external dependencies. CPU arithmetic reconstruction and GPU experimentation have separately documented scopes. IEEE templates, manuscript sources and author portraits are excluded from this software archive. The manuscript is not an accepted publication.
